long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Saeed bin Dalmook bin Juma Al Maktoum belongs to Dubai's ruling family through his late father, Sheikh Dalmook bin Juma. He joined five brothers in hosting an Iftar gathering attended by Dubai's ruler, a rare public appearance that placed their family branch within the wider Al Maktoum dynasty.

His public role is chiefly ceremonial and dynastic. A Seychelles order granted Sheikh Saeed bin Dalmook Al Maktoum the privileges and immunities of a diplomatic agent as a named dignitary in 2020. The Dalmook patronymic marks his branch of the dynasty and distinguishes him from other Al Maktoum royals called Saeed.
